title: Undirected reachability is in randomized log space
statement: The language of encodings of finite undirected graphs with a designated source and target joined by a path is decidable by a randomized finite Turing machine using logarithmic space. It halts after a fixed number of random bits on each input, accepts yes-instances with probability at least $2/3$, and rejects no-instances on every random string.
